text: Zero Spam. Quiet by Design. Infinite inboxes, so nobody ever gets your real address. Give every company its own — when one leaks, you delete it, not your life. Pick one based on who you're handing the address to. 01 · One-sender The first person or company to write claims the address for good. Everyone else is rejected at the door — so a resold or breached list is worth nothing. chase@yourname.clova.email 02 · Temporary Set a lifetime — an hour for a download link, a month for a trial. When it's up the inbox turns mail away, and can wipe what it holds. 03 · Prefix Claim a prefix of five characters or more, then anything you add after it already works — no setup, and no dash needed. Each address still locks to its first sender. $0 forever $30 /year $2.50 a month, billed yearly $50 /year $4.17 a month, billed yearly * Limits are 100 messages per day in the Free plan and 1000 in Pro and Business. MCP Connect Claude, Cursor or any assistant that speaks MCP, and hand it the inbox chores: a fresh address for a sign-up, the code that just arrived, every receipt from March. It gets only the permissions you give it. Make me an address for the gym trial, and tell me the code they send. Privacy & export We don't sell it, we don't read it and we don't track you. You can export your entire dataset at any time, on any plan. How the three inbox types work together in one mailbox. Sign in with a Google account, a passkey, or a username and a password. With Google, Clova.Email receives only your email address, your name and your profile photo: the address is how we know it is you, and the name and photo fill in your profile, where you can change or remove them. We never use any of it for advertising, never sell it and never share it. The whole of it is in our privacy policy .
